name: Michael Everett
title: Assistant Professor; Autonomy & Intelligence Laboratory Director
department: Electrical and Computer Engineering; Khoury College of Computer Sciences
fitReason: Direct intersection of learning-enabled physical autonomy and certifiable control, including learned terrain risk integrated with planning.

physicalEvidence.summary: SPARTA (CoRL 2025) demonstrates learned point-cloud traversability on an AgileX Scout Mini; Appendix F specifies Ouster OS1-128 and onboard RTX4070. Its prebuilt-map assumption and simulated tire-deformation surrogate remain limitations; 91% versus73% is a simulation result. September2026 SCRAMPPI additionally documents40 Scout Mini hardware trials with onboard planning, but is numerical HJ/MPC rather than a learned policy. The adversary is simulated and recovery manually triggered. Current official faculty roster identifies SPARTA first author Zihao Dong as his PhD student.

shortVisit.summary: Current join page offers PhD/postdoc routes and specifically addresses current Northeastern MS students with no MS hiring funding. No external-master’s visitor invitation found. The forms are interest collection, not admission or a summer offer.
